description: The reason the Deep Reach never got thinned has a name now, because Dredge gave it one: the Midden. A hundred drowned things grown into one heaving hulk, and it's getting bigger. Go down to the Deep Reach and end it before it decides the cistern looks warm.
name: The Thing That Doesn't Thin

objectives.desc: Kill the Midden in the Deep Reach, the deepest point of the works. Go in fed, lit, and armed.
emotes: {who} stands their ground against the Midden as it bears down.
